def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            color_cells = {}
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen[r][c] = True
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                color_cells.setdefault(grid[y][x], []).append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] != 0:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            layers = []
            for color, cells in color_cells.items():
                ys = [p[0] for p in cells]
                xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
                area = (max(ys)-min(ys)+1) * (max(xs)-min(xs)+1)
                layers.append((area, color))
            layers.sort(reverse=True)
            colors = [color for _, color in layers]
            mapping = dict(zip(colors, colors[::-1]))
            for color, cells in color_cells.items():
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = mapping[color]
    return out
